cause.proximate_text: The most likely cause of the A-A MCR chiller trip was a low oil level within the sump due to oil migration to the chiller's evaporator. Oil migrated during low load conditions which produced low compressor discharge pressures and an overall low refrigerant flow velocity. The low sump oil level caused a loss of oil pressure and a subsequent oil failure trip.

notes: Official cause code is TBD per FORM-366 fields, so cause node marked provisional despite narrative providing a clear technical cause statement (oil migration). B-B chiller outage is a pre-existing condition/contributing failure mode that combines with the A-A trip to create the reportable consequence, per rule 5's parallel-trigger modeling. No component failed per Section IV.D (N/A), so no Manufacturer node needed. Previous similar LER is for Unit 2 (docket/title as stated in narrative); stub key preserved exactly as written (391-2025-001-00).
